user.title: Choose your PSE&G portal
user.description: Pick the MyMeter portal for this account: PSE&G New Jersey, or PSEG Long Island. The next step asks how you want to sign in.

auth_method.title: Choose how to sign in
auth_method.description: Easiest: MyMeter email and password. Use a password you do not use anywhere else. PSE&G can still ask for another check, for example a CAPTCHA, and the dialog then asks you. Okta cookies work only on the New Jersey portal and expire in about an hour.

mymeter_login.title: Sign in with your MyMeter login
mymeter_login.description: Enter the email and password of your MyMeter login (the Email/Password boxes on your MyMeter portal: mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com, or mysmartenergy.psegliny.com on Long Island). Home Assistant stores that login in this integration's config and uses it for MyMeter's own sign-in, not Okta, so Okta's two-factor prompt is not used. How long that keeps working without you is not verified: PSE&G can still ask for another check, for example a CAPTCHA, and the dialog then asks you. Use a password you do not use anywhere else.

mymeter_cookie.title: Sign in with a MyMeter cookie
mymeter_cookie.description: Paste the MM_RememberMe value, or the full Cookie header, from a signed-in MyMeter Dashboard request. Sign in with Remember Me on, then copy it from your browser's developer tools. Setup accepts the cookie only if MM_RememberMe can renew the session by itself, so it can be rejected even while your browser is still signed in. If it is rejected, sign in with your MyMeter email and password instead.

okta_cookies.title: Sign in with Okta cookies
okta_cookies.description: PSE&G New Jersey only. Click 'Sign in Via My Account', then paste the Cookie header from the id.myaccount.pseg.com /sso/saml request; it should contain idx=. Okta sessions expire in about an hour and need periodic manual pasting, so use this only if the MyMeter methods do not work.

captcha.title: PSE&G CAPTCHA Sign-In
captcha.description:
PSE&G wants a CAPTCHA that Home Assistant cannot solve itself. Solve it in a desktop browser and hand back one proof. Google's reCAPTCHA response is only valid for about two minutes, and Home Assistant drops this pending sign-in after ten minutes without a proof.

1. Open {helper_url} and download the helper extension ZIP. Extract it, then in {chrome_extensions_url} (or {edge_extensions_url}) enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the extracted folder; pin the helper if you like.
2. In another tab, open {portal_url}, click the helper's toolbar button (the panel shows Ready), then click Sign In and solve the CAPTCHA yourself.
3. While the helper is active it blocks the portal's own login request. Press Copy verification in the panel before the proof expires, then Close helper (or reload the tab) to restore the portal login.
4. Paste the proof into the masked CAPTCHA field below and submit. The pending sign-in lasts ten minutes, but the proof is only valid for about two minutes.
5. If PSE&G refuses a proof solved in a different browser, capture a fresh one; this path has been seen working on only one desktop browser, so other browsers and unattended renewal are not verified.

The proof can be used only once and is never saved.

error.missing_credentials: Enter your MyMeter email and password.
error.missing_cookie: Paste the cookie into the field above.
error.okta_nj_only: Okta sign-in is PSE&G New Jersey only. Clear the Okta Cookies field.
error.captcha_nj_only: The CAPTCHA helper works only on the PSE&G New Jersey portal. Sign in with a MyMeter email and password, or paste a browser cookie from the Long Island portal.
error.okta_session_invalid: The Okta session cookies provided are expired or invalid.
error.okta_no_session: These Okta cookies cannot sign in on their own. On mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com, use the 'Sign in Via My Account' link (not the email/password boxes), then copy the Cookie header from the id.myaccount.pseg.com /sso/saml request. It should contain idx=.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to PSE&G. Please check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with PSE&G.
error.remember_me_failed: The Portal Cookies contain MM_RememberMe, but MyMeter did not sign in with it on its own. Sign out, sign in again with the Email/Password boxes and Remember Me ON, then copy the Cookie header from a Dashboard request.
error.login_failed: MyMeter did not accept that email/password. Check it on your MyMeter portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com, or mysmartenergy.psegliny.com on Long Island), then try again.
error.security_step_unsupported: MyMeter asked for a security question or a password change, which Home Assistant cannot answer. Complete it at your MyMeter portal (mysmartenergy.nj.pseg.com, or mysmartenergy.psegliny.com on Long Island), then try again.
error.captcha_response_required: Paste the CAPTCHA proof from the helper page.
error.captcha_proof_used: That CAPTCHA proof was already sent. Capture a fresh one with the helper and paste it here.
error.captcha_rejected: PSE&G did not accept that CAPTCHA proof. Capture a fresh one with the helper and try again.
error.captcha_busy: A CAPTCHA sign-in is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.sign_in_busy: A PSE&G sign-in is already running in this dialog. Wait for it to finish, then submit again.
error.login_redirected: PSE&G sent the MyMeter email/password sign-in to its Okta account page. Home Assistant refuses to follow that redirect, so the saved login never goes to Okta; this account may need the Okta cookie method instead.

abort.already_configured: This PSE&G account is already configured.
abort.login_updated_existing: The saved sign-in for this PSE&G account was updated.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: The provided credentials belong to a different account than the one configured.
abort.captcha_cancelled: CAPTCHA sign-in cancelled. Start again when you are ready.
abort.captcha_expired: This CAPTCHA sign-in expired after ten minutes without a proof. Start again and capture a fresh proof.
abort.captcha_not_pending: No CAPTCHA sign-in is waiting for a proof. Start again from the PSE&G sign-in form.
abort.sign_in_cancelled: The sign-in attempt was closed before it finished. Nothing was saved.

init.title: PSE&G Energy Options
init.description: Configure settings for PSE&G Energy. Turning off statistics imports stops automatic, deferred and manual recorder writes; sign-in and keepalive keep running.

reauth_required.title: PSE&G Authentication Required
reauth_required.description: Your PSE&G session has expired. Please re-authenticate under Settings > Devices & Services > PSE&G.

backfill_history.name: Backfill Energy History
backfill_history.description: Fetches historical daily energy consumption and cost from the PSE&G portal and imports them into Home Assistant Long-Term Statistics.

start_date.name: Start Date
start_date.description: The starting date to backfill from (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 2 years ago if left empty.

end_date.name: End Date
end_date.description: The ending date to backfill to (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today if left empty.

set_cost_mode.name: Set Cost Mode
set_cost_mode.description: Sets the operator cost sampling mode for PSE&G real-cost evidence capture (off or evidence).

cost_mode.name: Cost Mode
cost_mode.description: Cost mode to set (off or evidence; import is reserved and refused in v1.7.0).

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Specific PSE&G config entry ID to configure (optional; applies to all entries if omitted).
